comparison.objective: Insert a circuit board fully into an antistatic bag and place the released package in a crate; candidate adjusts and validates an industrial shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Record tests bimanual bag holding, thin-part insertion into a narrow cavity, transport, placement, and release. Candidate tests small-tool seating, counterholding, collar rotation, setscrew locking, and iterative physical cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires complete board containment, correct crate placement, release, and stillness without dropping either item. Candidate requires two safe dynamic stops without bottoming, hard-stop contact, excessive rebound, overload, or setting drift; several candidate tolerances are not yet numeric.
comparison.reason: Bimanual coordination is shared only generically; cavity insertion and package placement are meaningfully different from tool-mediated tuning and dynamic-response verification.
